# dprint_markdown_formatter v0.7.1 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [DprintMarkdownFormatter](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [DprintMarkdownFormatter.AstProcessor](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.AstProcessor.md): AST processing utilities for extracting and formatting module attributes.
- [DprintMarkdownFormatter.PatchBuilder](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.PatchBuilder.md): Utilities for building replacement strings and patches for formatted content.
- [DprintMarkdownFormatter.StringUtils](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.StringUtils.md): String processing utilities for markdown formatting.

- Core
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.md): A fast markdown formatter using dprint-plugin-markdown via Rustler NIF.
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Config](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Config.md): Configuration management for DprintMarkdownFormatter with proper type safety and
validation.

  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Error](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Error.md): Error utilities for DprintMarkdownFormatter.

- Sigil
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Sigil](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Sigil.md): Provides the ~M sigil for embedding formatted markdown content in Elixir code.

- Internal
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Native](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Native.md): Native interface for dprint markdown formatting using Rustler.
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Validator](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Validator.md): Input validation utilities for DprintMarkdownFormatter.

- Exceptions
  - [DprintMarkdownFormatter.Error.ValidationError](https://dprint-markdown-formatter.hexdocs.pm/DprintMarkdownFormatter.Error.ValidationError.md): Error when input validation fails.
